content.text: Perfect! Now let me create a final list of all files in the output directory:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && ls -lh *.md5 *.py *.tsv *.md *.txt 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $9, "(" $5 ")"}' && echo "" && echo "Total files for archive:" && ls -1 *.md5 *.py *.tsv *.md *.txt 2>/dev/null | wc -l
input.description: List all archive files with sizes
